name: Opacity-Weighted Trilinear Interpolation Volume Rendering
aliases: Opacity-Weighted Color Interpolation for Ray Casting
Opacity-Weighted Material Color Interpolation for Volume Rendering
definition: A volume rendering technique that improves accuracy by calculating voxel material colors using opacity weighting before interpolation, and computing lighting directly on resampled points rather than interpolated shading values, thereby avoiding color distortion and Mach band artifacts.
summary: Opacity-Weighted Trilinear Interpolation Volume Rendering is a ray casting technique that interpolates the product of opacity and material color to prevent color distortion and intermediate colors at material interfaces.
